# listmonk_list (Data Source)

Looks up one listmonk list by `id` or by exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a list that is not managed by Terraform, e.g. one created in the UI.
data "listmonk_list" "default" {
  name = "Default list"
}

output "default_list_subscribers" {
  value = data.listmonk_list.default.subscriber_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the list.
- `name` (String) Name of the list.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the list.
- `optin` (String) `single` or `double`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `archived`.
- `subscriber_count` (Number) Number of subscribers (only filled in by `listmonk_list`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the list.
- `type` (String) `public` or `private`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the list.
